The distribution of the [[cha2ds2-vasc|CHA2DS2-VASc]] score among patients with [[atrieflimren]] reveals distinct differences in risk profiles between men and women. Because this comparison is based on a single dated section from the 2024 report, no longitudinal trends can be established; the data provides a cross-sectional snapshot of risk stratification by gender [^src1]. 

Men represent the leaders in the lowest risk category, with 21.44% of the male population scoring a 0, compared to only 13.46% of women [^src1]. In absolute numbers, 17,164 men achieved a score of 0, while 7,586 women fell into this lowest risk bracket [^src1]. Conversely, women lead in the middle-tier risk scores. For a score of 1, women account for 36.06% of their demographic, whereas men account for 34.34% [^src1]. This pattern continues at a score of 2, where 32.39% of women and 27.15% of men are represented [^src1]. 

As the risk score increases, the percentages for both genders decline. Women consistently maintain a slightly higher proportion in the mid-to-high risk categories up to a score of 3 (14.22% for women vs. 12.34% for men) [^src1]. At the extreme tail of the distribution, the numbers become very small, acting as statistical outliers in the broader dataset; for instance, only 25 women (0.04%) and 55 men (0.07%) reached the maximum recorded score of 6 [^src1]. The total population analyzed comprises 80,045 men and 56,375 women, indicating that the male cohort is substantially larger overall [^src1]. There are no explicit clinical targets or thresholds marked as met or missed in this specific tabulation; rather, the table serves to illustrate the underlying demographic risk distribution, highlighting that female patients tend to cluster in the intermediate risk scores, while male patients are more heavily represented in the lowest risk category [^src1].

Rows compare: køn · Columns show: CHA2DS2-VASc score og procentandel

| Køn | CHA2DS2-VASc score | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | I alt |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| K | Antal % | 7586 13.46 | 20327 36.06 | 18260 32.39 | 8019 14.22 | 1850 3.28 | 308 0.55 | 25 0.04 | 56375 |
| M | Antal % | 17164 21.44 | 27489 34.34 | 21730 27.15 | 9875 12.34 | 3075 3.84 | 657 0.82 | 55 0.07 | 80045 |

Entities: cha2ds2-vasc, atrieflimren

Summary: Tabellen viser, at mænd har en højere andel af lavere CHA2DS2-VASc-scorer (0: 21.4% vs. kvinder 13.5%), mens kvinder har en højere andel af midterste scorere (1–2), hvilket afspejler kønsforskelle i risikoprofil.
